title: #68 Sports Stars
prompt: Successful sports stars and glamorous film stars act as role models for youngsters. Do you support this or not?

plan.focus: evaluate the role of famous sports and film stars as role models for youngsters, considering both positive and negative influences.
keyArguments: Famous sports and film stars can serve as positive role models by promoting healthy lifestyles and good behavior.
However, their influence can be negative due to potential misrepresentation and lack of proper guidance.
